name: Field Guide
line: A naturalist's field guide in book spreads: Bradbury's fern faces the title page; on Plate II, callout lines draw from three field marks to Redouté's rose (the full bloom for tobacco, a small bud for processed meat, the printed name for their shared Group 1 label); the four groups are look-alikes, the explorers two cloth-bound field guides and the games junior guides.
notes: Besley and Atkinson Hyperlegible are Latin-only on Google Fonts, so the RU and ZH pages would need other faces. Atkinson Hyperlegible draws a slashed zero by design, so key figures are set in Besley. The callout lines need JavaScript and a screen at least 861px wide; otherwise the numbered markers on the plate match the numbered notes. The chronic cover uses a darker sky (#46667C) so its cream title passes AA. The bloom and bud are a visual metaphor; the exact figures are in the text.
